B. FIXED MODE — AUTHORITATIVE 8014 EVENT-SLICED ATTRIBUTED-SLEEVE SEMANTICS
Implement using EXISTING Build3 genuine event lineage/dedupe and EXISTING SERVICE_STATE_FILE only. NO new authority store.

F1. One genuine deduplicated post-baseline OPEN event -> exactly one fixed-notional follower slice for that leader-wallet/coin sleeve.
F2. One genuine distinct INCREASE event -> exactly one additional fixed-notional slice for the same sleeve.
F3. Each opening/increase slice size = fixed_notional_USD / authoritative current mark_price; independent of leader-event magnitude.
F4. Sleeve accumulates the attributable fixed slices.
F5. REDUCE -> follower closes the same fraction of CURRENT attributed sleeve as leader closing fraction for that corresponding leader transition.
F6. CLOSE -> that attributed sleeve becomes zero.
F7. FLIP -> close 100% old attributed sleeve, then create exactly one new opposite-side fixed slice.
F8. Other leaders' sleeves and unrelated/manual same-coin inventory untouched.
F9. norm_base does not size fixed entries; proportional mode only.
F10. proportional mode unchanged.

EVENT AUTHORITY:
Exactly one semantic exposure-increasing leader EVENT can mint one slice.
Raw fill fragments, WS duplicates, replay rows, recovery snapshots, startup positions, rebaseline/current-position observations mint ZERO new slice authority.
Existing G2 event-lineage/dedupe authority remains binding.

FORBIDDEN DEFECT:
BLIND_FIXED_NOTIONAL_PER_RAW_FILL / REPLAY / SNAPSHOT authority, and treating REDUCE/CLOSE as another fixed slice.
The primitive fixed_notional/price is allowed only as size for ONE already-authorised OPEN/INCREASE slice. It MUST NOT itself authorise an order.
